commands.evidence: AttachedDevice wire contract now carries repeated transports while retaining the legacy primary transport field.
Bridge pairing joins ADB and remote-control under one stable Android identity, persists the join, and upgrades legacy schema.
Portal provider forwards the caller bearer token to Bridge, projects one device surface with distinct transport capabilities, and preserves phone-to-host identity.

passedCases.assertion: one paired device exposes distinct ADB and remote-control capabilities
attached phone and remote host retain distinct linked target identities

limitations: This validates the Bridge-to-Portal provider boundary and durable topology model with deterministic fixtures. It does not claim a live enrolled remote phone or remote desktop control session.
